Grammar in Context

Mauritania: A Country of Contrasts

Comparative Adjectives

Read the text and choose the correct answer (A, B or C) for each gap.

Mauritania is a large country in West Africa. Much of the country is covered by the Sahara Desert, so many parts of Mauritania are (1) ___ than places near the coast.

The capital, Nouakchott, is one of the biggest cities in the country. It is (2) ___ than many other towns in Mauritania and has more shops, schools and services.

One of Mauritania’s most unusual forms of transport is its famous iron ore train. The train is (3) ___ than most ordinary passenger trains and can be several kilometres long.

The journey across the desert can also be (4) ___ than a normal train journey. Passengers may spend many hours travelling through hot and dusty areas.

Life near the Atlantic coast can feel (5) ___ than life deep in the desert because temperatures are often less extreme there.

  1. A. dryB. drierC. driest
  2. A. busyB. busierC. busiest
  3. A. longB. longerC. longest
  4. A. difficultB. more difficultC. most difficult
  5. A. comfortableB. more comfortableC. most comfortable
View Answers
  1. B — drier
  2. B — busier
  3. B — longer
  4. B — more difficult
  5. B — more comfortable
